title: Customer-residency-aware encryption evidence compactifier and key-rotation summarizer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an evidence 'compactifier' service that ingests raw KMS/HSM rotation and access events and emits per-tenant compacted timelines suitable for audit export and regulatory reporting. The service must be residency-aware (align events with configured tenant residency and retention policies), apply retention tags, deduplicate equivalent rotation events across zones, and produce a small, verifiable bundle that preserves cryptographic provenance without shipping needless event noise. This reduces exported evidence size for customers and speeds compliance exports while preserving forensic fidelity.
acceptance_criteria: Generates a compact evidence bundle no larger than 10% of the raw event stream for standard tenant workloads (measured on staging sample dataset)
Bundles include per-event residency stamp, retention-category tag, and a credibility score for each compressed group
Support for HSM-signed rotation attestations and KMS metadata: key_id, wrapping_algorithm, region, and event_timestamp
End-to-end automated export to compliance S3 with manifest and SHA256 checksum; validated by compliance QA
No change to existing customer-facing APIs or key material; passive read-only integration with audit streams
design_decisions: Use a sharded summarizer keyed by tenant_id + region to minimize memory blast radius and allow parallel compaction
Coalescing window defaults to 15 minutes but is tunable per-tenant via retention profiles stored in config service
Credibility scoring heuristic: HSM-signed > KMS-signed > internal-log-only; penalize incomplete residency metadata
Persist compacted bundles as zstd-compressed ndjson plus a separate signed summary manifest for lightweight verification
Fail-safe: on unknown schema or missing signature, mark event as 'raw_forced' and include full event to preserve forensics
implementation_notes: Prototype written in Go; uses existing audit-stream consumer library (pkg/audit/consumer) to avoid new dependencies
Leverage existing Kinesis->Kafka bridge from ENG-421112 for ingestion; implement backpressure via partition-aware checkpoints
Add unit tests for coalescing logic with 0ms, 100ms, 5s, and 15m windows to verify edge-case ordering
Benchmarks on p3.2xlarge staging: compaction throughput 50k events/sec single shard with median latency 120ms
Add feature flag 'evidence.compactifier.v1' to gate rollout and enable canary exports for 3 enterprise tenants
